Context: 6. Medical Advance

Special provisions.In the case of the following artificial appliances, once the instrument/ equipment is prescribed by the Specialist in a Government/recognized hospital, the Administrative Ministries/ Departments would make the payment direct to the supplying agency and not to the Government servant:-  
- (i)
- Supply of the Heart Pacemaker and the replacement of its Pulse Generator.
- (ii)
- {iii)
- Replacement of diseased Heart Valves.
- Artificial Electronic Larynx.
- (iv) Artificial Hearing Aid.
